details: The October Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% month-over-month, with core inflation increasing by 0.3%, exceeding analysts' forecasts. This data heightened expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in December, leading to a decline in Bitcoin's price below its $73,000 support level and triggering liquidations across the broader cryptocurrency market.
title: US Inflation Hotter Than Expected, Fuels Fed Hike Bets, Dents Crypto

details: The European Central Bank (ECB), European Commission, and the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) have launched a joint initiative to develop common standards for tokenized securities. The goal is to establish uniform rules for holding and settling securities across blockchain networks and traditional financial systems, with the first standards anticipated by early 2028.
title: ECB, EU Regulators Collaborate on Tokenized Securities Standards

details: Cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and Ethereum, fell to two-month lows due to mounting investor concerns. These concerns include potential stricter US crypto regulation following the midterm elections, significant net outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs (exceeding $1.28 billion in a week), and the ongoing repercussions from a major $6 billion hack involving Binance.
title: Crypto Markets Slide Amid Regulatory Fears, ETF Outflows, Binance Hack Fallout

details: Piero Cipollone, a member of the ECB Executive Board, called on European Union lawmakers to finalize legislation for a digital euro by the end of 2026. He emphasized the digital euro's crucial role in enhancing Europe's payment autonomy amidst a volatile geopolitical environment. A pilot phase for the digital euro is expected to commence in the second half of 2027.
title: ECB Urges EU Lawmakers to Finalize Digital Euro Bill This Year

details: Between July 2025 and June 2026, Western Europe's crypto economy expanded by 1.2% to $2.08 trillion, establishing it as the world's second-largest. This growth was notably driven by a 131% surge in stablecoin holdings and increased cross-border activity, indicating resilient adoption by both institutions and retail investors despite a broader global market downturn.
title: Western Europe's Crypto Economy Grows Amid Global Downturn
